sources.description: The Atlanta Falcons capped off Week 4 with an emphatic 45-24 win, spoiling the New Orleans Saints “Domecoming” anniversary. Billed as the villain throughout the production, the team embraced the role and broke the Bayou’s hearts. The Falcons are now 2-2 and looking better than ever. Here are the Week 4 Snap reactions.
